meta.note: Levels as published: establishment and worker counts are estimated absolute numbers; GVA per worker / per establishment and emoluments per hired worker are ₹ per year. The activity aggregate ("All") and establishment-type totals are PUBLISHED source rows, not computed here. GVA-per-worker refers to market establishments as titled in the source. Per-hired-worker metrics are not baked for OAE (own-account establishments have no hired workers), and the 2023-24 round publishes them for HWE only — the *_all variants end at 2022-23 (trailing null is a source publication change, not a fetch gap). GVA-per-establishment is baked for All only: the source's HWE and OAE rows for that indicator are mislabeled (the published All reconciles as a weighted mean only with the two labels inverted); the mislabeled rows are quarantined here and retained as served in the raw archive. Survey years are fiscal, plotted at April of the first year; only three rounds exist (2021-22 to 2023-24).

Per-1000 rates as published. Act-wise registration rates are NOT exclusive (one establishment can register under several acts) and do not sum to anything; "Not registered" is the clean complement of registered-under-at-least-one. Bank-account rows: "maintaining any" is the headline rate; owner-name and establishment-name accounts are its published components. The franchise series is an absolute count, not a rate.
